status: Bank-specific scenario estimates using shared macro v1; regulatory threshold 13% corroborated by September 2026 BoG Monetary Policy Report; not investment advice.

anchor.method: Use observed September balance sheet and year-to-date earnings. Q4 estimated from 9M run rate with scenario multiplier. 9M gross loans and allowance missing: estimate year-end net then gross using explicitly estimated allowance/gross ratio; no historical imputation.

loan_growth.method: 2027 onward nominal GDP growth approximation = shared real GDP growth + CPI inflation, plus bank-specific spread in percentage points; 2026 Q4 net loan growth applied to September actual. Annual growth capped/floored at -10% and 35% to avoid unstable extrapolation.
loan_growth.reason: FY2024/FY2025 gross loan growth approximately 50%/49%; FY2026 September net loans 25,229.224m vs 16,038.002m at FY2025; assume growth normalizes rather than perpetuating exceptional expansion.

deposit_growth.method: Nominal GDP approximation plus spread; 2026 Q4 from September deposit balance.
deposit_growth.reason: FY2025 deposits grew about 20.5%; September 2026 deposits 50,404.889m versus 41,048.267m at FY2025.

investment_yield.method: Use 50% shared 364-day T-bill and 50% representative government bond yield; portfolio mix proxy, not reported.
investment_yield.reason: Government securities repricing matters; maturity-level weighted yield not yet verified.

loan_yield.method: Shared policy rate plus scenario spread (percentage points).
loan_yield.reason: Standalone loan-specific yield has not yet been reconciled to interest-income notes; spreads are analyst stress assumptions.

cost_of_funds.method: Interest-bearing funding cost = shared policy rate multiplied by factor; use average deposits and wholesale borrowings; effective blended cost, not quoted deposit rate.
cost_of_funds.reason: FY2025 interest expense 1,571.799m divided by average FY2024–25 deposits and borrowings is approximately 3.86%.

fee_growth.method: Shared nominal GDP proxy plus spread; preserve expense/income ratio unless stress applied.
fee_growth.reason: FY2025 fee income 1,131.697m vs 780.431m in FY2024; normalize exceptional growth.

opex_growth.method: Shared CPI inflation plus percentage-point spread.
opex_growth.reason: Staff and other expenses grew rapidly in FY2025; inflation plus growth-related overhead is a transparent sensitivity, not guidance.

cost_of_risk.method: Loan impairment charge / mean gross loans; scenario percentage. No repeat of FY2022 DDEP event assumed; stress captured by higher costs, not an unverified sovereign haircut.
cost_of_risk.reason: FY2025 loan impairment 188.797m against mean gross loans approximately 14,881m (1.27%).

npl_pct.method: 2026 year-end based on reported 9M 4.8%; subsequent scenario target, not forecast from loan-level data.

allowance_to_gross_pct.method: Gross loans = net loans / (1 - allowance ratio) at FY2026E; later allowance stock = gross x ratio.
allowance_to_gross_pct.reason: FY2025 reported 1,789.120m / 17,827.122m = 10.04%; 9M2026 gross/allowance unavailable. Lower base ratio is a scenario assumption reflecting reported NPL improvement, not an observed allowance.

tax_rate_pct.method: Effective tax on positive PBT; no automatic deferred tax benefit for losses.
tax_rate_pct.reason: FY2025 total effective tax 35.39% (recompute 1,119.530 / 3,163.498); GCB25AGM p.161 reports 35.34%, a small unexplained presentation difference; 25% corporate rate plus two 5% levies. 9M2026 35.05%. Forecast uses blended 35%; future levy law changes not assumed.

dividend_payout_pct.method: Payout on positive PAT; constrain if capital target or cash minimum breached.
dividend_payout_pct.reason: Scenario payout sensitivity, actual historical dividends not yet modeled.

capital_ratio_target_pct.method: Management buffer (pp) above shared minimum CAR, not an official target; estimate RWA intensity from FY2025 RWA / assets; independently flag minimum shortfall.
capital_ratio_target_pct.reason: FY2025 regulatory capital and RWA disclosed; 9M2026 reported CAR 14.6%; no verified interim RWA/capital breakdown.

q4_income_runrate_multiplier.method: Scale Q4 revenues by scenario multiplier; Q4 funding expenses multiplied by 1.25 downside/0.9 upside/1 base, OPEX 1.10 downside/1 upside/1 base, Q4 risk charge by estimated gross loans and scenario risk/4; keep actual 9M flows fixed.

fx.method: Hold disclosed FY2025 USD quantities constant for illustrative translation of 2027 onward opening exposures; convert USD positions using shared year-end GHS/USD movement. FX translation of net position flows through trading P&L; avoid double-counting by including it only once. Q4 2026 FX translation not separately estimated because September balances already include YTD and current USD stock not disclosed. EUR/GBP translation omitted and flagged.

cash_reserve.method: Proxy required reserve = scenario CRR x year-end customer deposits. Cash+BoG balances include noneligible cash, so this is a liquidity screening test, not regulatory compliance.

model_structure.method: Hold noncore balance sheet lines proportional to deposit growth, except property/other assets grow with opex, stated capital and other reserves constant; securities follow deposit growth; cash balances plug the accounting identity, flag negative balances/reserve shortfall without automatically borrowing. RWA = gross loans + FY2025 calibrated residual risk intensity x (total assets minus gross loans). Q3 regulatory capital anchored on reported CAR x estimated RWA; Tier1 capital anchored using FY2025 Tier1/total regulatory capital relationship. Retained profit increments regulatory capital; constrain dividends to pre-dividend cash and CAR buffer. Report proxy, not regulatory returns.
model_structure.q3_allowance_ratio_source: FY2025 actual allowance/gross; carry-forward approximation for interim RWA only
model_structure.q4_opex_balance_growth: Annual opex growth divided by four for Q4 property and other assets; fee expense run-rate uses separate funding multiplier only for interest expense and scenario fee expense ratio multiplier for fee expense.
model_structure.allowance_bridge: Allowance stock target is separate from impairment flow; implied write-offs/other movements = opening allowance + loan impairment charge - closing allowance. Negative is unmodelled additional allowance build, not an observed recovery. 2026 opening allowance proxy only; report separately.
model_structure.cash_residual: Do not hide negative cash; show reserve and funding gap. Cash includes reported cash+BoG aggregate so regulatory compliance not established.

notes: All numeric driver assumptions are analyst estimates, not reported bank results or management guidance.
2026 income statement must retain reported 9M results plus separately estimated Q4; model checks must flag any liquidity or capital shortfall.

Shared macro v1 numeric paths now used. Regulatory minimum 13% corroborated in Bank of Ghana September 2026 Monetary Policy Report, https://www.bog.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Monetary-Policy-Report-September-2026.pdf; current GCB summary does not state the minimum. Minimum paid-up capital 400m carried from shared source with verification caveat.

macro_snapshot.note: Use all three shared scenarios; rerun after macro revisions. Missing required driver is a hard error.
